title: Pattern and Word Ring generator

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Put variation inside a repeatable tool, because multiple designers need a way to create new outputs without losing the system’s structure.
strategic_value: A shared generator can give the Museum flexible patterns while keeping the circular vocabulary consistent.
demonstration: A tool interface pairs a left control panel and palette grid with a large canvas cycling through letter rings and contextual Word Rings at different scales, positions and colors.
practical_value: Identify which aspects remain structurally consistent while the generator varies the output.

content_islands.name: Controls
content_islands.spec: Keep sliders, fields and palette choices in a narrow left sidebar.

content_islands.name: Live canvas
content_islands.spec: Use the broad right area for the changing circular output.

content_islands.name: Variation sequence
content_islands.spec: Show centered and cropped patterns, letter rings and word rings across different color combinations.

reference_purposes.Expression: A tool interface pairs a left control panel and palette grid with a large canvas cycling through letter rings and contextual Word Rings at different scales, positions and colors.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram says the generator enables static and motion outputs and helps designers maintain both consistency and flexibility.

ingredient.name: Pattern and Word Ring generator
ingredient.role: Enable variation within a recognizable circular vocabulary.
ingredient.application: Use the generator’s controls to vary letter or word rings, scale, position and palette.
ingredient.scope: Demonstrated authoring tool; the source supplies no downloadable generator here and small interface values are not transcribed.
